# Wazir Cutlery Ltd — Master Artisan Cutlery & Damascus Blades

> Wazir Cutlery Ltd is a world-renowned artisanal forge situated in Wazirabad, Punjab, Pakistan—the historic cutlery capital of South Asia. For generations, our master blacksmiths have specialized in hand-forging pattern-welded Damascus steel knives, authentic stag horn antler cutlery, high-carbon outdoor hunting bowies, and functional collector swords.

## Core Brand & Metallurgy Overview

- **Location & Heritage**: G.T. Road, Wazirabad, Punjab, Pakistan. Wazirabad is globally recognized as the historic center of blademaking craftsmanship, where traditional anvil-and-hammer techniques meet precision vacuum heat treatment.
- **Blade Metallurgy**: 
  - Pattern-welded Damascus steel forged from alternating layers of 1095 high-carbon steel and 15N20 nickel alloy steel.
  - Folded between 256 and 512 true layers to produce distinctive ladder, twist, raindrop, and feather Damascus patterns.
  - Hardness: Vacuum heat-treated and oil-quenched to 58–60 HRC for optimal edge retention and toughness.
  - Mono-steels: D2 Tool Steel, 1095 High Carbon, 440C Stainless, and VG-10 core Damascus.
- **Handle Materials**:
  - 100% genuine ethically collected naturally shed deer stag horn (antler).
  - Stabilized exotic hardwoods: Walnut Burl, Rosewood, Olivewood, Ebony.
  - Custom solid brass, nickel silver, and Damascus steel guards and pommels.
- **Leathercraft**: Each knife includes a custom, hand-stitched full-grain cowhide leather sheath fitted with belt loops and brass snap closures.

## Product Categories & Offerings

- **Chef & Culinary Knives**: Damascus 8-inch chef knives, Santoku, Nakiri vegetable cleavers, and Damascus steak knife sets with stag horn handles.
- **Hunting & Bushcraft Knives**: Heavy-duty full-tang Bowie knives, tracker knives, skinning knives, and survival blades with Rockwell 58–60 HRC.
- **Folding & Pocket Knives**: Liner-lock and lock-back Damascus EDC pocket knives with thumb studs and stag horn scales.
- **Historical & Collector Swords**: Damascus Viking swords, Witcher swords (Aerondight), Medieval broadswords, and Ottoman scimitars.
- **Custom Bespoke Commissions**: Tailor-made blade profiles, personalized name chiseling, and unique metallurgy specifications upon patron request.

## Global Logistics & Patron Guarantee

- **International Delivery**: Worldwide express air freight to over 80 countries via DHL Express and FedEx International Priority (typical transit 2–4 business days).
- **Complimentary Delivery**: Free worldwide shipping on orders exceeding $150 USD.
- **Packaging Protocol**: Blades are anti-corrosion oiled, sheathed, boxed in rigid collector presentation packaging, and legally declared under international HS tariff codes 8211 and 9307.
- **Artisan Guarantee**: 30-day home inspection period and Lifetime Forge Warranty covering metallurgical bonding and structural integrity.
